title: Recruiting Workbench
description: Mockup of Joule on SmartRecruiters and SuccessFactors: a control tower for the hiring pipeline and an evidence-based shortlist where Joule proposes and the hiring manager decides. Fictional sample data.
insights: Overview, Pipeline, Time to fill and Morning brief show where hiring is stuck, on aggregated numbers.
Shortlist compares CV text with the criteria the hiring manager set, with the proof line for each result. Joule never rejects anyone.
Approvals holds every proposed change (status move, message). Nothing is written until a person releases it.
Fictional sample data, pseudonymous candidates. The recruiting_* tools and the Supabase tables exist; no SmartRecruiters or SuccessFactors system is called.
prompt: Bundled example: Recruiting Workbench (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
